title: Formulation of a Moisturizer Gel and Evaluation of Antibacterial, Anti-inflammatory, and Antioxidant Activities of Erythrina crista-galli L. Flower Ethanol Extract
core_idea: Assess the antioxidant, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory activities of ethanol extract from Erythrina crista-galli L. flowers and formulate the extract into a moisturizing gel with acceptable physical quality, using in vitro (DPPH, disc diffusion), in vivo (carrageenan-induced paw edema), in silico studies, and physical evaluation of the gel.
tldr: Study aims to evaluate bioactivities (antioxidant, antibacterial, anti-inflammatory) of E. crista-galli flower ethanol extract and to develop a physically acceptable moisturizer gel formulation, combining laboratory assays, animal testing, in silico analysis, and formulation quality assessment.
